title: Happy Thanksgiving!
summary: MarineMax wishes you a happy thanksgiving!
body_markdown:
On behalf of everyone at MarineMax, we would like to wish you a wonderful Thanksgiving! We are grateful for the journeys we've shared on the water and beyond. All the best to you and your loved ones during this special day.


## Thanksgiving Leftover Recipes


Got turkey? Well, we at MarineMax have some suggestions for those Thanksgiving extras! These boat-friendly, Turkey Day leftover recipes are perfect for an early morning or afternoon on the water, or for dinner on the dock. Take a look at our favorite 11 recommendations!


[Recipe Ideas](https://www.marinemax.com/blogs/boating-lifestyle/best-thanksgiving-leftovers-ideas-for-the-boat)


## Black Friday-Style Savings


Browse MarineMax’s best savings of the season! Start this holiday season right with a new boat to create everlasting memories with your loved ones.


[Shop Now](https://www.marinemax.com/collections/promotions)


## Blue Friday


Blue is the new black! While tons of people run to the stores to take part in Black Friday, take part in a relaxing Blue Friday to spend the day out in the water! Check out our article to learn what it is all about.[Learn More](https://www.marinemax.com/resources/news/blue-is-the-new-black)
